study_design: Prospective cohort analysis in UK Biobank using baseline biomarkers and follow-up linkage for prostate cancer incidence and mortality.
reason: The abstract analyzes overall prostate cancer incidence and prostate cancer mortality. Mortality is not an incident aggressive prostate cancer endpoint, and the abstract states that future research will examine tumor characteristics. The exact analytic participant count is unavailable because biomarkers were measured in up to 211,754 men.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Prostate cancer incidence was positively associated with circulating vitamin D, urea and phosphate concentrations and inversely associated with glucose, total protein and aspartate aminotransferase.
estimate_classifications.reason: The vitamin D estimate concerns overall incident prostate cancer, not aggressive disease. Its numeric HR and confidence interval come from supplied full-text evidence, while the abstract establishes the general incidence endpoint.
